dispute_description: Amritdhara Pharmacy is the proprietor of the well-known trademark AMRITDHARA used in respect of a medicinal preparation sold across India for several decades and enjoying widespread consumer recognition. Satya Deo Gupta has launched a competing medicinal preparation under the mark LAKSHMANDHARA, which Amritdhara Pharmacy contends is phonetically and deceptively similar to AMRITDHARA. The visual and phonetic similarity, combined with identical product categories and target consumers, creates a false impression that LAKSHMANDHARA is associated with or approved by Amritdhara Pharmacy, thereby causing consumer confusion and misrepresentation. No prior contractual relationship exists between the parties. Amritdhara Pharmacy seeks a permanent injunction restraining Satya Deo Gupta from using the mark LAKSHMANDHARA or any deceptively similar mark, and damages for passing off.
